Deadline Looms for Income Tax Returns Filing

August 31 is the final deadline for filing Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the financial year 2022-23. Failure to meet this deadline will result in penalties, including a late filing fee and double interest on outstanding tax amounts. Additionally, taxpayers may lose out on significant benefits.
